title: Supported kernels and regular three-generator hypertopes

clauses.statement: The exact displayed involutory presentation with the parity commutator relator defines the constructed group.

clauses.statement: The three pair products have exact orders2^s,2^t,2^ell.
The maximal-parabolic coset incidence system is a regular rank3 hypertope with this full type-preserving automorphism group.
clauses.proof: U.SK.Helly,U.SK.Geometry; source base is A square polytope

clauses.statement: The three pair-power subgroups are pure cyclic coordinates of orders2^(s-2),2^(t-2),2^(ell-1); their internal direct product has quotientH_(delta+5).
For even delta the quotient is (D_(2^((delta+4)/2))^2) semidirectC2; for odd delta it is (D_(2^((delta+3)/2))^2) semidirectC2^2. The extension dot asserts no splitting.
clauses.proof: Section2 all-integer square/diagonal affine decompositions; source printed parity rows corrected
